pages.text: A tub of soapy water stood in the yard. Each child held a round bubble wand.
Bobo dipped the wand deep in the soapy water. Bobo would make the biggest bubble.
As soon as the wand went in, Bobo pulled it sharply out. Soapy water dripped.
Bobo quickly blew hard. "Just blow!" A bubble started to emerge, then popped.
A huge bubble slowly swelled from Mio's wand. Bobo was already swinging a wand about.
Bobo's bubbles popped as soon as they appeared. Only half the soapy water remained.
Bobo put down the wand. Only the others' bubbles floated in the yard.
Teacher Bau held a wand and waited quietly. "When the soapy water spreads all the way across, the bubble grows big."
Bobo held the wand and waited quietly. A thin film spread across its ring.
Blowing slowly, Bobo made a bubble bigger than their face. It floated over the roof.
